name: Control Station
author: justarieldotcom
description: Modular bento dashboard: pick which cards are on it, arrange them, and resize each one. Pick any of those cards to also show it inline in the bar. Also a panel module, so the dashboard can be summoned as its own window: omarchy-shell shell summon justarieldotcom.control-station '{}'

barWidget.description: Bento dashboard with Weather, Market, Calendar, Companies House, System, Reminders, Media, Timer, Inbox, VPN, Containers and Repos. The bar shows whichever cards you tick, in your order.

schema.label: Dashboard cards
schema.description: Cards on the dashboard, in this order. The DASHBOARD group in the plugin's settings (gear) inside the panel does the same thing, picking cards as chips and reordering them by drag-and-drop. The first six are the sensible default; the rest are opt-in.

options.label: Market
options.description: Price and change for the symbols below

options.label: Calendar
options.description: Next events from the iCal URL

options.label: Repos
options.description: Git working trees and their branch state

schema.label: Bar cards
schema.description: Cards to show inline in the bar, in this order. Leave empty for the plain icon. Reorder and pick the bar's section and slot from the plugin's own settings (gear) inside the panel.

options.label: Market
options.description: Price and change for the symbols below

schema.label: Bar symbols
schema.description: Subset of the market symbols below that reaches the bar, comma-separated, up to 3. Leave empty for the first 2 symbols.

schema.label: Weather location
schema.description: Town name for Open-Meteo geocoding. Leave empty to disable weather card.

schema.label: Market symbols
schema.description: Comma-separated Yahoo Finance symbols. Display order follows this list exactly (first symbol appears first).

schema.label: Company numbers
schema.description: UK Companies House registration numbers, comma-separated for multiple companies (e.g. 00445790,08740764). Leave empty to disable.

schema.label: Show card headers
schema.description: Show the card name and checked time in each box header. Off gives bodies the full box height.

schema.label: Panel zoom
schema.description: Overall panel scale (also adjustable by dragging the corner grip while resizing).

schema.label: iCal URL
schema.description: Google Calendar secret iCal link (basic.ics). Leave empty to disable.

schema.label: Repo paths
schema.description: Git working trees for the REPOS card, one path per line or comma-separated. A leading ~ is expanded. Leave empty to hide the card.
VPN client used by the VPN card: openvpn, nordvpn, openconnect or any nmcli-capable name.
